causal_protocol.availability: ten-second bar available at start plus ten seconds; source prefix frozen before trigger; original minute support clocks unchanged
forbidden: present-day reference data backfilled into history
causal_protocol.input: exact original activation completed bars, independently authenticated plan and trigger, and original causal-prefix hash
causal_protocol.missing_or_invalid_prefix: fail unresolved; never convert to strategy withhold
runtime_order: verify point-in-time source and session evidence
bind recomputed ordinal and both-arm dispositions to every original trigger
independently replay all paired account paths

evaluation.complete_gate: all dates retained and all paired paths verifiable/flat complete under unchanged strict observed-update policy; unresolved source/account gaps block aggregate financial conclusion
evaluation.counterfactual: independent once-seeded chronological account replay for each arm; never subtract filtered saved fills or reuse control balances
evaluation.missing_dates: retain unavailable; never replace, treat as zero, or silently omit; verified zero-opportunity dates remain
evaluation.no_pooling: accounts/scenarios/horizons share dates and opportunities; not independent samples
evaluation.primary: main_account baseline_conservative horizon_1s: child terminal net P&L minus control terminal net P&L after frozen fees
evaluation.profitability: positive difference with negative child P&L is loss reduction, not profitability
report_all: all 24 paths separately, no best-cell selection
entry exposure, fill fractions and fees
session-close drawdown, win rate and profit factor with undefined values explicit
best closed trade removed per arm without rerunning or reselection
evaluation.strict_quote_withholds: require complete original stream evidence under the separately registered strict observed-update policy; keep unavailable-source history visible
evaluation.support: positive primary difference with at least one closed child entry is descriptive directional support only; zero or negative difference does not support the hypothesis; zero child entries is inconclusive

hypothesis: Restricting otherwise valid Micro entries to causal pullbacks one and two improves paired net P&L versus unchanged Micro on the fixed new panel.
next_gate: verify repository date exclusions and parent integrity; freeze a separate paired-runner/source-binding implementation and bounded provider availability/cost plan before any acquisition or evaluation

one_change.anchor: original profile-union activation qualification; no reset on withheld triggers, fills, re-entry, or a new peak
one_change.ordinal: unchanged causal_active_pullback_number at original completed plan prefix

prior_outcomes_already_known: All 30 baseline dates and ordinal cohorts were inspected; first and second cohorts also lost. They are not holdout evidence.
rationale: MB-ENT-006 prefers early pullbacks; a hard cap of two is an experimental translation, not an exact source-authored threshold.

sampling.contamination_response: invalidate and preserve entire registration; no automatic replacement or re-selection
